description: Read every offer from Amazon. Reads the offers on Amazon for 1 credit, refunded if it doesn't answer. A read made in the last 3 hours, by anyone, is returned instead, for free (charged: false). The answer is the same as GET /offers.

marketplace.description: Amazon store, e.g. com for amazon.com Allowed values: com, co.uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, co.jp, com.br, com.mx, in. Default: "com".

refresh.description: Read Amazon again unless the last read is under 5 minutes old (1 credit) Default: false.

name: fetch_offers
title: Read every offer from Amazon
